states.content: Asha Patel is at the clinic for an urgent neurology follow-up after an emergency-department visit; she had a first seizure-like spell two nights ago, and the ED asked her to see neurology this week. The ED note describes her presentation as a probable first unprovoked seizure. Asha is the patient with the seizure workup. Nurse Lucy is bringing her back for vitals and the neurology intake questions.
states.subject: patient_asha_patel

states.content: Plan for Asha Patel: brain MRI with and without contrast, routine EEG, levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily starting tonight, and no driving for 6 months. Levetiracetam has now been started. Clinician Dr. Mehta confirms the calendar update is fine and instructs Asha to keep taking levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily starting tonight. Clinician Dr. Mehta further instructs Asha to keep taking levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily and to keep the no-driving restriction in place, and Asha acknowledges and agrees to keep taking levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily and to keep the no-driving restriction in place. Nurse Omar reports Asha should continue levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily. Pharmacist Iris counsels levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, no driving for 6 months, and no swimming alone. Nurse Omar instructs Asha to take levetiracetam at the same morning and evening times each day, and Asha agrees to take levetiracetam at the same morning and evening times each day. Nurse Omar restates the current medicine and restrictions as levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, no driving for 6 months, and no swimming alone. Pharmacist Iris advises Asha to keep taking levetiracetam even though the routine EEG was normal, and Asha agrees to keep taking levetiracetam despite the normal routine EEG.
states.subject: patient_asha_patel

states.content: Asha Patel's updated calendar has three visits: EEG on Friday April 4 at 2:00 PM, MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM. These replace the first-booked times of Thursday April 3 at 8:00 AM EEG, Monday April 7 at 6:30 PM MRI, and Thursday April 10 at 10:00 AM neurology follow-up. Asha states she needs later appointments and that morning testing will not work this week. The routine EEG has now been completed without complications, and preliminary neurology review found the routine EEG is normal; nurse Omar reports the routine EEG is normal. Asha Patel reports no change yet in her status after the EEG. The MRI remains scheduled for Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM, and a reminder was sent for that MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM; Asha confirms she saw the MRI reminder for Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM. Clinician Dr. Kim states that a normal routine EEG does not change the current plan today for Asha Patel. For the EEG, the EEG department asks patients to arrive 20 minutes early with clean, dry hair and no gel or styling products. Scheduler Noah confirms the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM remains booked. Scheduler Noah states the remaining scheduled items before closure of Asha Patel's workup are the MRI on Tuesday April 8 at 7:15 PM and the neurology follow-up on Friday April 11 at 11:30 AM.
